verdict.rationale: Docs confirm cards can be added to Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay, but there's no documentation of the push-provisioning entitlements process, in-wallet card art configuration, or manual provisioning fallback details — only a generic one-line mention of wallet support. missing for 10: entitlements/certificate process for push provisioning, in-wallet card art specification, manual provisioning fallback flow, independent/hands-on confirmation.
